sources.class: peer-reviewed Great Basin structural geology reference
sources.status: structural synthesis cited by DOE INGENIOUS
sources.excerpt: Structural controls of geothermal activity in the Great Basin region: ~39% of systems are blind (no surface hot springs or mapped Quaternary scarps), preferentially hosted in step-overs, relay ramps, fault terminations, and intersections.
sources.supports: Physical mechanism for blind geothermal Radon strike corridors, Andersonian 60-deg normal-fault up-dip gravity back-projection, and shallow hydrothermal magnetite destruction.
sources.limits: Conceptual structural framework; predictive gain must be verified empirically on spatially-blocked holdout.
